The '''22nd Producers Guild of America Awards''' (also known as '''2011 Producers Guild Awards'''), honoring the best [[Film producer|film]] and [[television producer]]s of 2010, were held at [[The Beverly Hilton|The Beverly Hilton Hotel]] in [[Beverly Hills, California]] on January 22, 2011.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Kilday |first1=Gregg |last2=Block |first2=Alex Ben |title='King's Speech' Takes Top PGA Award, Shakes Up Awards Race |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/kings-speech-takes-top-pga-74671 |accessdate=March 29, 2020 |work=The Hollywood Reporter |date=January 22, 2011}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Producers Guild of America Announces 2011 Producers Guild Award Winners |url=https://www.producersguild.org/news/57175/PRODUCERS-GUILD-OF-AMERICA-ANNOUNCES-2011-PRODUCERS-GUILD-AWARD-WINNERS.htm |publisher=Producers Guild of America |accessdate=March 29, 2020 |date=January 24, 2011}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=THE KING'S SPEECH Upsets THE SOCIAL NETWORK at the 2011 Producers Guild Awards|url=https://collider.com/producers-guild-awards-2011/|last=Bettinger|first=Brendan|website=Collider|access-date=August 27, 2017|date=January 23, 2011}}</ref> The nominations were announced on January 4, 2011.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Finke |first1=Nikki |title=Producers Guild Releases Film & TV Noms |url=https://deadline.com/2011/01/producers-guild-announces-film-tv-noms-93787/ |website=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |access-date=January 8, 2025 |date=January 4, 2011}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Producers Guild Of America Announces Theatrical Motion Picture and Television Nominations for 2011 |url=https://www.producersguild.org/news/news.asp?id=55819 |publisher=Producers Guild of America |accessdate=March 29, 2020 |date=January 4, 2011}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Producers Guild Award Nominees Announced|url=https://collider.com/producers-guild-of-america-awards-nominees/|last=Goldberg|first=Matt|website=Collider|access-date=August 27, 2017|date=January 4, 2011}}</ref>
